hero.subheadline: A national project competition with INR 10,000 in prizes
hero.valueProposition: Present a technical project on Women Empowerment or Open Innovation across three rounds and compete for cash prizes, certificates, and national recognition.

content.whyJoin:
Samarthya 2026, organised by the SKN IEEE Student Branch, is a national-level project competition that gives students a platform to present impactful technical projects and receive feedback from industry experts and academicians. The competition runs three rounds - a project proposal presentation, a prototype video, and a final jury presentation - so you get structure guidance and multiple chances to refine your work.

With themes focused on Women Empowerment and Open Innovation, you can solve real, women-centric social challenges or pursue a creative problem from any domain. Prizes total INR 10,000, including a dedicated Best Women-Centric Project award, plus certificates and national recognition.
content.whoShouldApply:
This is for students at any recognised college, in teams of one to four, who want to present and build an innovative technical project and compete against talent from across the country. Inter-college teams are permitted, and participants from Pune and other cities can apply.

Teams choose either the Women Empowerment or Open Innovation theme, so whether you are building for social impact or a general technical challenge, there is a track for you.
benefits: Cash awards for the winner, runners-up, and Best Women-Centric Project
Feedback from industry and academic expert judges
tips: Register before the registration deadline on 8 August 2026
Prepare a clear project proposal presentation for Round 1
Film a concise prototype video for Round 2 to demonstrate your solution
Tie your project clearly to either the Women Empowerment or Open Innovation theme
If you are based in Pune, plan to present in person at the final on 12 August

shouldYouApply.idealFor: This is ideal for a student or student team that wants a structured, recognised platform to present a technical prototype, compete nationally, and receive expert feedback with a chance to win cash prizes.
goodFit: A student with a technical project or prototype
A team working on women-centric social challenges
An innovator with a practical problem from any domain
A student who wants feedback from industry and academic experts

faq.question: Who can participate?
faq.answer: Students from any recognised college. Teams of one to four members are allowed, including inter-college teams from Pune and other cities.

faq.question: What are the themes?
faq.answer: Participants choose Women Empowerment (technology-based solutions to women-centric challenges) or Open Innovation (innovative solutions for practical problems from any domain).

faq.question: What is the prize pool?
faq.answer: The total official prize pool is INR 10,000: winner INR 5,000, first runner-up INR 2,500, second runner-up INR 1,500, and Best Women-Centric Project INR 1,000.

faq.question: When is the registration deadline?
faq.answer: 8 August 2026. The final project presentation is on 12 August 2026.

submissionGuide.detail: Sign up via the Unstop listing before 8 August 2026.
Submit your project proposal or PPT presentation by 10 August 2026.
Record and submit your prototype video by 11 August 2026.
Present to the jury on 12 August 2026, in person at SKNCOE, Pune for Pune teams, or online for shortlisted teams outside Pune.
